name: DeepWiki (Cognition)
install: claude mcp add -s user -t http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
recommendation_reason: pre-digested architecture summaries are cheap Tier-2 context for large PUBLIC repos (a ~2K-token wiki page vs exploring 15 files); DATA EGRESS: sends repo identity and queries to a third-party cloud — policy-deny for private or client code; treat summaries as potentially stale vs recent commits and never trust them for Tier 0/1 decisions without verifying against source
